notes.title: Jump For Joy!
notes.content:
- After much contemplation, I've decided to add mid-air movement in the game. Should help with the final level :)

- In the first round, the lights in the waterfall won't turn back on if they've been turned off. 

- Minor tweaks in level design and movement

- Game speed restarts correctly
